generations.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a COMPLETELY NEW photographic composition of the CYMBA One wired earbuds. This is a professional commercial STUDIO PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPH aesthetic, captured with a camera, not a CAD illustration or shiny CGI render. The attached image is a HARDWARE CONSTRUCTION REFERENCE ONLY. Do NOT copy its arrangement, upright poses, viewing angle, framing, surface texture or lighting.

NEW COMPOSITION: camera looks down at the product at a 40-degree angle, using an 85mm macro lens. Both earbuds are physically RESTING ON THEIR SIDES, low on the same level, close together as a compact pair, at different natural rotations and slightly different depths. The left/front bud lies on its side with its softly domed oval outer faceplate facing up towards the camera; the silicone fin is foreshortened and rests sideways, not standing vertically. The right/rear bud lies at a contrasting diagonal, tilted enough that the inner contact area and silicone ear tip are partly visible, naturally occluded rather than every engineering detail facing the camera. Neither earbud is upright or hovering. The slim controller lies off-axis to their lower right, secondary in visual importance, at roughly a 20-degree diagonal. Fine braided cables fall in a relaxed single broad curve in the foreground, join through a small Y-junction, connect to the controller, and continue to a USB-C plug. The complete group and all cable ends fit in frame with clear transparent margins. A quiet, asymmetric, carefully styled but believable tabletop product arrangement, with no row of two upright objects.

LIGHT: one very large diffused studio softbox upper left, weak white bounce right. Subtle directional falloff, short soft grey contact shadows immediately beneath actual resting points, natural reflections. No bright perimeter outlining, no cinematic rim light, no luminous halo, no HDR effect, no glowing sensor. Focus on the front earbud; the slightly more distant controller has a mild natural optical softness, but remains recognizable. Neutral daylight color, tasteful photographic contrast, premium audio catalog quality, realistic camera optics.

MATERIALS: sealed deep graphite/smoke-black molded shells, nearly opaque with only a trace of translucency at thin edges, no exposed internals. Smooth satin graphite faceplates with a subtle soft reflection, fine muted champagne edge trim, restrained polished bevels. Soft charcoal silicone fins and clean neutral grey eartips with realistic thickness. Matte molded finish with extremely fine natural microtexture, not leather, scratched metal or glossy liquid plastic. Flush warm champagne contacts, dark optical glass. Immaculate retail hardware, not a prototype.

PRESERVE LOCKED DESIGN: compact oval/teardrop IEM body, subtly domed dark outer faceplate and narrow champagne rim, curved soft concha fin; two separate oval metal stimulation contacts on the inner landing area below the fin; one small dark recessed optical window on the inner side in one ear; one acoustic nozzle and replaceable grey silicone tip per bud, slim flush conductive inserts in the tip; bottom cable exits through short strain reliefs, no over-ear loop. Slim three-button minus/center/plus graphite controller, tiny white indicator and USB-C. Natural occlusion is welcome. Do not invent other ports, chips, parts, a charging case or branding.

OUTPUT: landscape 3:2 composition. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA everywhere outside the hardware and short semitransparent contact shadows, as if a real studio shot was expertly clipped from its seamless background. No visible tabletop, backdrop, rectangle, fake checkerboard, environment, text, watermark, gradients or halo. Keep the product grounded through pose and subtle contact shadows, despite the transparent background.

generations.role: Fresh text-only generation establishing the new camera and composition
generations.prompt:
A high-end commercial product photograph of a finished pair of compact wired in-ear monitors, professionally photographed for a premium audio catalog and expertly cut out to a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. This must look like small physical consumer electronics under a studio softbox, with real camera optics and believable manufactured surfaces.

Photographic art direction: a three-quarter overhead camera view, 65 degrees down toward the objects. The two earphones lie flat on their sides as someone carefully placed them on the studio table, close together at differing diagonal angles; the rear earphone sits a little behind the front one. Low, grounded silhouettes. One outer face points diagonally up toward camera; the other earphone reveals part of its skin-facing side naturally. Small soft contact shadows keep the pair grounded. The dark inline controller lies diagonally alongside them on the right, and the fine cable loosely follows a broad relaxed curve below. Everything feels casually precise, not symmetrical or posed like a diagram. A complete neatly arranged product, centered with generous clear margins, landscape 3:2.

Exact CYMBA product architecture: compact rounded teardrop/oval in-ear bodies. Smooth softly domed MATTE graphite-black outer faceplates edged with a very fine muted champagne-metal rim. Deep smoke-black housings that conceal internals, with faint translucency only at edges. Each has a short inward-facing sound nozzle and one replaceable soft grey silicone eartip with a dark central mesh bore. Slim flush champagne conductive inserts integrated into the tip surface. A curved flexible charcoal silicone concha fin emerges from the inner body and curls gently to one side, shaped for fitting inside the ear, never an over-ear hook. Two flush small oval champagne stimulation contacts lie together on the broad inner surface below the fin. One small, dark, recessed optical window beside them on the inner side of ONE earbud, not bright green. A fine black braided cable exits the BOTTOM of each earbud through a small integrated strain relief. Two leads join a subtle Y splitter and connect to a slim pill-shaped graphite controller with three low-profile buttons: minus, center, plus; a single tiny white status dot. Its other end connects by a short lead to a proper male USB-C connector. No extra parts or disconnected cables.

Material and light: smooth soft-touch molded graphite, restrained satin metal trim, silky silicone. A broad diffused white light source from camera left and very gentle fill. Realistic tonal separation between metal, polymer and silicone. Soft reflections stop naturally on the curves; no glowing outlines or glossy mirror shells. Restrained microtexture only, not grainy leather. Modest optical depth of field, front earphone sharp and far cables subtly softer, no artificial sharpening. Quiet photographic color, neutral daylight.

Output genuine transparent alpha with clean edges around all objects and between cables. Preserve only short, faint, semitransparent contact shadows. No visible floor or backdrop, no rectangular background, no glow or halo, no platform, no decorative elements, no text, logo or watermark.
